versions.name: RXV2-0.9.621-adjustments
versions.notes: Adjustments page: the switch positions are now decoded the way Rotorflight stores them (signed 5-microsecond steps around 1500, so 'whole travel' reads 900 to 2100, not 4175), channels are named AUX1 to AUX13 as in Rotorflight, each line says in plain English whether a knob sets the value or a switch nudges it up and down, and the page has a help screen (Malcolm 2026-09-11: 'slightly mysterious'). Includes 0.9.620.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.620-usb-clean
versions.notes: Dongle over USB: Adjustments and the Command line, proven on a Nexus. The 'reply bigger than the link buffer' alarm no longer fires for legitimate USB replies. Includes 0.9.619.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.619-usb-jumbo
versions.notes: Dongle over USB: big replies (255 bytes and more, e.g. the adjustments list) are now parsed in Rotorflight's real jumbo-frame order - size, command, then the 16-bit length. Includes 0.9.618.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.618-usb-breadcrumbs
versions.notes: Dongle over USB: after a crash the boot log says which USB step was running (diagnostic build). Includes 0.9.617.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.617-usb-only-pages
versions.notes: What only USB can do (Malcolm 2026-09-11): a Command line page (every Rotorflight setting by name, with Save and Leave buttons) and an Adjustments page (a knob or switch changing a setting in flight - the 588-byte list the radio link could never carry). Both say plainly that they need the flight controller's USB socket plugged into the dongle when it is not. Factory reset is allowed over USB only. Includes 0.9.616.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.616-dongle-usb2
versions.notes: Dongle over USB: page requests now get their answers (the waits that pump the UART drain the USB link too). Includes 0.9.615.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.615-dongle-usb
versions.notes: Dongle: MSP over USB. Plug a Rotorflight flight controller's USB-C into the dongle and it is used automatically - no port setting, no wiring; the UART link carries on otherwise (Malcolm 2026-09-11: 'so that nothing is impossible'). The dongle's USB socket is a host while this runs (updates by WiFi/Bluetooth; USB flashing needs the button-held bootloader). Includes 0.9.614.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.614-pill-fix
versions.notes: Updates page: the status pill no longer offers 'tap to install' while an install is already running. Includes 0.9.613.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.613-dongle-name
versions.notes: Dongle setup now has the dongle's name at the top (type, Rename); Setup loses its rename button on a dongle (Malcolm 2026-09-10). Includes 0.9.612.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.612-dongle-setup
versions.notes: Setup page on a dongle: the dongle button simply says 'Dongle setup' (Malcolm 2026-09-10). Includes 0.9.611.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.611-dongle-no-mode
versions.notes: Dongle page on a dongle: the Mode choice (automatic / always a dongle / always a receiver) is gone - a dongle has no transceivers and never will - leaving only the port speed. A receiver keeps the choice (Malcolm 2026-09-10). Includes 0.9.610.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.610-keep-close
versions.notes: Backup page: 'Keep the phone close to the model until the backup is complete' is the first line while a backup runs, and a struggling link shows live ('weak link, move closer' once three reads have needed a second try; apps 4.52/4.44 report it). Malcolm 2026-09-10. Includes 0.9.609.
